source_industry: service business — local trades and services
hero_signature: Full-bleed industry hero photo with dark linear gradient overlay anchored at the bottom. Content stack sits bottom-left (NOT centered): accent-tinted pill chip → Archivo Black uppercase H1 → 1-2 line subline → two-CTA row (primary filled + secondary outline). Below the hero, the page transitions to a light off-white background with charcoal text — the cinematic darkness is contained to the hero only.

section_flow.notes: Bracketed business name on the left, 6-7 nav links centered, accent-filled CTA pill on the right. Sits transparent on the hero, swaps to light background on scroll.
Industry hero photo + dark linear gradient + bottom-left content anchor + accent pill chip + Archivo Black h1 + 2-CTA row.
Light cards on off-white background. Industry-specific service names, 2-3 sentences each, accent-colored Lucide icon.
Industry photo left, two-paragraph story right. Trust badges underneath in a 4-up row.
One large pull quote in Archivo Black, then quieter attribution line.
Dark band (matches hero overlay color), display headline, body line, single accent-filled CTA. Sits before the footer.
Tagline left, nav columns center, social/contact right.

notable_features: Light page background (off-white) with cinematic dark hero only
Accent pill chip ABOVE the headline (mini-CTA / status badge)
Two-CTA row pattern (primary filled + secondary outlined)
Archivo Black uppercase H1 throughout the family
Per-industry accent color (orange base, swapped per skin: cyan HVAC, blue plumber, lime landscaper, pink groomer, safety-orange construction)
Reveal scroll-fade-up on every section via shared Reveal component (prefers-reduced-motion honored)
Gallery + Process + FAQ + Service-Area pages share the same scroll choreography
motion_vocabulary: Reveal component: opacity 0→1 + translateY 24→0 over 700ms with [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] easing on viewport-enter, once-only
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → skip the motion, render immediately
Hero photo stays static; the dark overlay is a pure CSS gradient (no animation)
tailwind_extras_inline_css: Color tokens via CSS variables (--accent-*) so each skin's next.config.mjs ships its own accent without rebuilding components. The Reveal component is a thin Framer Motion wrapper. The Hero component renders (not next/image) so static-export with output:export works without basePath issues for public-folder assets.
